description.text: Professional Overview：The major of Fine Arts Education belongs to the education category within the broad category of education and physical education. The professional level is junior college (higher vocational education), and the basic duration of study is three years. This major mainly studies the basic theories related to fine arts, enabling students to master scientific educational theories and teaching methods, receive training in the basic qualities and abilities of teachers, cultivate students' ability to organize extracurricular fine arts activities, equip them with initial research and creation capabilities, understand the development trends and cutting-edge topics of fine arts education at home and abroad, and initially master a foreign language. Be able to read foreign language books and periodicals of this major.Training Objectives：This major is dedicated to cultivating well-rounded talents in terms of morality, intelligence, physical fitness, aesthetics and labor. The training objectives of different schools vary in focus. Generally speaking, they aim to cultivate students with a solid foundation in science and culture, as well as ideological and political theories, basic theories of education and teaching, and knowledge of fine arts, who possess good humanistic and scientific qualities and innovative consciousness, and have strong abilities in curriculum design and implementation, class construction and management, application of digital educational technology, and lifelong learning. High-quality educators with a spirit of craftsmanship and information literacy, who are capable of engaging in art education and teaching in primary schools, kindergartens and other fields.

duration.text: The Art Education at Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6111 USD/per year ￥ 44000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. The first page of a valid ordinary passport (the validity of the passport should be later than December 1, 2025), and a valid visa page or residence permit page (required for students in China).2. Four one-inch, bareheaded, white-background color photos taken within the last six months.3. Bachelor's degree or above or a pre-graduation certificate.Applicants who graduated from institutions within China must submit the Electronic registration and Verification Report of Academic Certificates of the Ministry of Education and the Online Verification Report of Higher Education Degrees of the Ministry of Education (https://www.chsi.com.cn).Applicants who graduated from overseas institutions must submit the "Certificate of Overseas Education and Degree" on the website of the China Academic Degrees and Graduate Education Development Center (https://www.cscse.edu.cn).Fresh graduates can first submit a pre-graduation certificate issued by their current school. Those who fail to submit their bachelor's degree certificates before enrollment will have their admission qualifications revoked.4. Complete transcript of the undergraduate stage. The transcript should be issued and stamped by the academic affairs department or relevant student management department of the school attended. Fresh graduates can first submit the current transcript issued by their school. Those who fail to submit the complete transcript of their undergraduate stage before enrollment will have their admission qualifications revoked.5. HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) Level 5 or 6 certificate (valid for 2 years).6. Two academic recommendation letters. Two recommendation letters from professors, associate professors or experts with equivalent technical titles in the applied professional field must be submitted, written in either Chinese or English (including the recommenders' handwritten signatures and valid contact information).7. Study and Research Plan in China. The text should be written in either Chinese or English. The main content should be over 1,000 words, including but not limited to personal study and work experience, academic research achievements, research plans during the master's stage, and personal development plans after graduation.8. Portfolio. A portfolio related to the applied major, with a brief introduction to each work (including the work name, size, creation time, creation description, etc.); Or the list and abstracts of published academic articles; Or other original academic achievements.9. Proof of economic status and guarantor of affairs in China.Submit a deposit balance certificate issued by the bank, with an amount of approximately 100,000 RMB or more. If the bank account is not held by the applicant himself/herself, proof of family relationship with the economic guarantor must be submitted simultaneously, such as: birth certificate, household register, notarized documents, etc.Submit the guarantor of the affairs in China along with a copy of the guarantor's identity document.10. Copy of the "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners". The examination results must be stamped with the official seal of the hospital and are valid for six months.11. "Admission Application Form for International Students of Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts" and Commitment Letter.12. Other supporting materials that may be required to be submitted.

requirements.text: 1. Non-chinese citizens holding valid foreign passports, with an age of no more than 35 years old in principle.2. Good health is required, and one must meet the physical examination standards for applying for a study visa or residence permit to China.3. Be friendly to China, abide by laws and regulations, have good conduct, be diligent and eager to learn, have excellent academic performance, no record of violating school rules and regulations, no public security penalties, and no criminal record.4. Those who come to China to pursue a master's degree must hold a degree equivalent to a bachelor's degree from a Chinese university.5. The score of the Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK) must reach level 5 or 6 (180 points or above).
